messages:
maria_cs: Quick heads-up — Willowknoll week1 VPC provisioning hit two gating items, need short triage. KMS key policy is rejecting our CreateGrant call; customer also reports SIEM egress to their Splunk endpoint is failing with TLS handshake dropped. Can we sync in the next hour?

devon_se: on it. can you paste the KMS error?

maria_cs: error from their logs: "AccessDenied: User is not authorized to perform: kms:CreateGrant on resource". They showed this snippet from the infra team.

leah_support: FYI I pinged the customer for the exact ARN and the role they're using. They said the role is willow-service-role@acct-992 (we asked for full ARN).

sam_eng: most likely policy needs "kms:CreateGrant" and "kms:ListGrants" allowed for the service principal used by our sidecar. Also ensure key policy allows the account principal. Small policy example:```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-sidecar"},
      "Action": ["kms:CreateGrant","kms:RetireGrant","kms:ListGrants"],
      "Resource": "*"
    }
  ]
}
```

nate_security: double-check the key's grant token expiration settings. If the customer is rotating, CreateGrant can fail if the key is pending deletion or disabled. Also check for a Deny in an SCP in org.

ashley_ops: I added a checklist item in the onboarding runbook and set a reminder for the customer to confirm the role ARN and KMS key status. Link: https://redwood.company/runbooks/private-onboard#kms-checks (customer won't see link).

devon_se: about the Splunk egress — what port and host did they test?

maria_cs: they tested: tcp to splunk-willow.prod.splunk.net:9997, TLS, client cert provided by their ops team. But packets seem to die at our egress NAT.

sam_eng: can you share the VPC flow logs? If NAT gateway isn't allowing ephemeral ports back, the TLS handshake can fail. Also check our egress SGs and the customer's firewall for 9997 outbound.

leah_support: customer attached a flow log snippet showing RST from our NAT at 10.24.7.1 -> 10.0.2.34:9997. They said it worked in their staging account.

sam_eng: quick test commands for them:```bash
# from bastion in customer VPC
curl -v https://splunk-willow.prod.splunk.net:9997 --tlsv1.2
# or nc -vz splunk-willow.prod.splunk.net 9997
```

nate_security: also confirm that our TLS inspection (if enabled on the private deployment) isn't intercepting. We had one tenant with a managed egress proxy that required an exception.

maria_cs: action items so far: 1) customer to share full KMS key ARN + IAM role ARN (they promised within 30m), 2) infra team to validate key policy and org SCPs, 3) eng to review NAT/egress SGs and confirm if TLS inspection is enabled, 4) CS to capture risk for renewal (if blocked >3 days escalate).

devon_se: I'll validate the key policy and check SCPs now. If org-level deny exists we need customer IAM admin to approve.

ashley_ops: capturing renewal risk: customer on a 12mo Dedicated onboarding contract, Week1 blockers flagged as potential timeline slip. Logging as "high" risk if unresolved in 72h. I'll mark in account health dashboard.

sam_eng: I found a likely misconfig: their key policy allowed our role ARN pattern in account 123456789012, but Willowknoll is in acct 992; they used a cross-account principal. I'll draft the minimal change and paste here after we confirm ARNs.

infra-bot: Ticket created: #CS-4712 Willowknoll KMS & Egress triage. Assigned: devon_se, sam_eng. Due: 2026-03-24T18:00:00Z.

leah_support: customer just sent role ARN and key ARN in secure message. I'll drop it in the ticket and ping when posted.

maria_cs: thanks everyone. Quick ask for postmortem capture once fixed: can we put notes into the onboarding feedback doc? Need to record friction points for the template.

nate_security: agreed — I'll add a short section for "cross-account KMS gotchas" and recommend a preflight check for org SCPs.

ashley_ops: I'll follow up with customer in 2h and update account health. If this clears today we keep baseline renewal risk. If not, we trigger escalation path. :thumbsup:

devon_se: updating ticket now with key-policy diff and steps. Will share the patch here then run through with customer.

sam_eng: will also validate NAT logs and share a short diag script we can ask the customer to run from their bastion.

maria_cs: perfect. closing loop for now — thx team.
